notes: Changes the existing Reports > Training Excel Report into one rolling Training Excel Tracker rather than adding another report. The same button now downloads a workbook with Current Status and Training History sheets. Current Status keeps the existing filterable compliance view. Training History contains every stored training sign-off as a separate permanent row, including completion date/month/year, person, department, reference, title, type, method, document version, acknowledgement, instructor, delivered date, renewal period and next due date. Historical rows include inactive assignments and are never replaced by a later refresher completion. No database change.
